```{r, load-data}
# load the image
load("processed_data/aggregating.rda")
# load the files table
# file_table <- fread('processed_data/file_table.csv.gz')
# locate
file_metadata[, local_file := file.path(sample_dt_dir, paste0(basename(file_path), ".tab.gz"))]
stopifnot(file_metadata[assay_type == "ChIP-Seq", all(file.exists(local_file))])

setkey(file_metadata, "local_file")
# write table back to file
fwrite(file_metadata, "processed_data/file_table.csv.gz")

# # we only need ChIP-Seq data, since WGBS has been aggregated via the matrices
# file_table <- file_table[assay_type == "ChIP-Seq"]

# load WGBS data
wgbs_agg <- fread(file.path(sample_dt_dir, "WGBS_agg.csv.gz"))
wgbs_agg <- wgbs_agg[!startsWith(name, "chromhmm")]
wgbs_agg <- melt(wgbs_agg,
  id.vars = c("ID", "ihec", "name"),
  value.name = "score",
  variable.name = "experiment_type",
  measure.vars = c("score", "n")
)
wgbs_agg[experiment_type == "score", experiment_type := "DNAm"]
wgbs_agg[experiment_type == "n", experiment_type := "CpGs"]

wgbs_agg[, ihec := sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", ihec)]

# bind all the samples for the histone marks
histone_dt <- rbindlist(
  pbmcapply::pbmcmapply(
    FUN = function(file) {
      dt <-
        fread(file)
      names(dt) <-
        c("name", "size", "covered", "sum", "mean0", "mean", "min", "max")
      dt[!startsWith(name, "chromhmm")]
    },
    file = file_metadata[assay_type == "ChIP-Seq", local_file],
    USE.NAMES = TRUE,
    SIMPLIFY = FALSE
  ),
  idcol = "local_file"
)
# some mapping for ids and histone marks
histone_dt[, c("ihec", "experiment_type") := file_metadata[local_file, .(epirr_id_without_version, experiment_type)]]
# histone_dt[, experiment_type:=file_metadata[local_file, experiment_type]]
setnames(histone_dt, old = "mean", new = "score")

# find common cols and rows
common_ihec <- intersect(histone_dt[, unique(ihec)], wgbs_agg[, unique(ihec)])
common_cols <- intersect(names(histone_dt), names(wgbs_agg))
```


```{r, build-aggregated-dt}
# bind histone and WGBS data
aggregated_dt <- rbindlist(list(
  histone_dt[ihec %in% common_ihec, ..common_cols],
  wgbs_agg[ihec %in% common_ihec, ..common_cols]
))

# some data wrangling to prepare the data for putting into wide format
aggregated_dt[, c("position", "ID") := tstrsplit(name, "_", fixed = TRUE)]
# there is an ID for all of them, so remove this line
# aggregated_dt[is.na(ID), c("position", "ID"):=list('event_name', position)]
# aggregated_dt[position=="up", position:="upstream_other_region"]
# aggregated_dt[position=="down", position:="downstream_other_region"]
aggregated_dt[, experiment_type := droplevels(experiment_type)]
aggregated_dt[, ihec := as.factor(ihec)]
aggregated_dt[, ID := as.integer(ID)]
# from long to wide
aggregated_dt <- dcast(aggregated_dt, ihec + ID ~ experiment_type + position, value.var = "score", sep = ";")
setnames(aggregated_dt, old = "ihec", new = "IHEC")
# write full table to disk
fwrite(aggregated_dt, "processed_data/aggregated_dt.csv.gz")
```


```{r, melt-psi}
# bring PSI values to long format for compatibility with the aggregated table
melted_psi <- melt(event_dt, measure.vars = sample_cols, id.vars = c("ID", "Event Type", "transcript_filter", "gene_id"), variable.name = "uuid", value.name = "PSI", variable.factor = FALSE)
melted_psi <- melted_psi[!is.na(PSI)]
# merge on uuid to get ihec from the file_metadata
melted_psi[file_metadata, on = .(uuid), IHEC := epirr_id_without_version]
```


```{r, expand-aggregated-dt}
# merge PSI on the aggregated table
aggregated_dt <- merge(aggregated_dt, melted_psi[ID %in% keep_rows_manual & !is.na(PSI), .(ID, IHEC, uuid, PSI, transcript_filter)], by = c("ID", "IHEC"))
aggregated_dt[melted_psi[ID %in% keep_rows_manual & !is.na(PSI)], on = .(ID, IHEC), c("uuid", "PSI", "transcript_filter") := .(uuid, PSI, transcript_filter)]
# remove NA PSIs
aggregated_dt <- aggregated_dt[!is.na(PSI)]
# NA for columns starting with CpGs can be replaced by 0
for (i in grep("^CpGs", names(aggregated_dt))) {
  set(aggregated_dt, i = which(is.na(aggregated_dt[[i]])), j = i, value = 0)
}

# gather the intrinsic features
cols_to_add <- c(
  "3ss", "3ssdown", "5ss", "5ssup", "distance_TSS", "distance_TES", "distance_gene_start", "distance_gene_end", "width;upstream_other_region", "width;event_name", "width;downstream_other_region", "Event Type", "gene_id", "seqnames", "Variability"
)

# add the intrinsic features
aggregated_dt[event_dt, on = .(ID), (cols_to_add) := mget(cols_to_add)]
# also add the protocol
aggregated_dt[file_metadata, on = .(uuid), protocol := experiment_type]
# add the ontology term and the project
aggregated_dt[
  metadata,
  on = c(IHEC = "epirr_id_without_version"),
  c("ontology", "project") := .(
    factor(harmonized_sample_ontology_term_high_order_fig1),
    factor(project)
  )
]


# load transcript ids per filter
filtered_transcript_ids <- readRDS("splicing_analysis/filtered_transcript_ids.rds")
# load isoform quantifications
isoform_quants <- fread("splicing_analysis/isoform_quantifications_subset.tsv.gz")
# compute gene-level quantifications
gene_quants <- rbindlist(sapply(transcript_filters, function(this_transcript_filter) {
  # subset the isoform quantifications to the samples we want to use
  this_filtered_transcripts <- filtered_transcript_ids[[this_transcript_filter]]

  # filter the isoform quantifications to the filtered transcripts and compute gene-level quantifications by summing the TPMs of the transcripts per gene
  isoform_quants_filtered <- copy(isoform_quants[transcript_id %in% this_filtered_transcripts])
  isoform_quants_filtered[effective_length > 0, RPK := 1000 * expected_count / effective_length, by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version)]
  isoform_quants_filtered[, TPM_rec := 1000000 * RPK / sum(RPK, na.rm = TRUE), by = .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version)]
  isoform_quants_filtered[is.na(TPM_rec), TPM_rec := 0]
  isoform_quants_filtered[, TPM_scale := 1000000 * TPM / sum(TPM, na.rm = TRUE), .(uuid, epirr_id_without_version)]
}, simplify = FALSE), idcol = "transcript_filter")


# manually change gene_id for ENSG00000213593.9_and_ENSG00000254462.1_and_ENSG00000211450.9_and_ENSG00000198561.13 from the manual ids that were kept
# aggregated_dt[gene_id == "ENSG00000213593.9_and_ENSG00000254462.1_and_ENSG00000211450.9_and_ENSG00000198561.13", gene_id := "ENSG00000198561.13"]
aggregated_dt[gene_quants, on = .(transcript_filter, uuid, gene_id), gene_expression := TPM_scale]

# make sure all of the gene_expression values are at least one: (deprecated because we don't have the suppa tpm filter anymore)
# stopifnot(all(aggregated_dt[, gene_expression >= 1]))
# log the expression, we do that later
# aggregated_dt[, gene_expression := log2(gene_expression)]

# remove the gene_id version
aggregated_dt[, gene_id := gsub(pattern = ".\\d+$", "", gene_id)]

# max promoter and summed enhancer are not used anymore
# # get the epirrs for which there is observed H3K27ac because only they have max_promoter and summed_enhancer
```
